purpose: AnomalousFiltersExtension provides four C++ ITK-based CLI modules for denoising medical images (particularly structural MRI, EPI/fMRI, and DWI/DTI volumes) using isotropic and anisotropic anomalous diffusion filters based on the porous media (Tsallis Fokker-Planck) equation. It is intended for researchers and neuroimaging users performing noise attenuation as a pre-processing step in 3D Slicer.
summary:
AnomalousFiltersExtension is a C++ CLI extension providing four ITK-based anomalous diffusion denoising filters for structural MRI, EPI, and DWI data. It is licensed under Apache 2.0, has no external dependencies beyond Slicer/ITK, does not modify the Python environment, and poses no security or safety concerns. Several non-blocking soundness and testing issues were noted (such as performing multiple iterations inside `ThreadedGenerateData` without thread synchronization, `homoLevel` not being wired up in `AADImageFilter.cxx`, and unadapted `--sigma` flags in the CTest files).

🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: Inspected all C++ source files (`.cxx`, `.h`, `.hxx`), XML descriptors, CMake files, and documentation. The code performs only local ITK image reading, mathematical filtering, and writing with no network activity, subprocess execution, or unsafe file operations.

environment.rationale: Inspected all `CMakeLists.txt` files and `requirements.txt`. This is a pure C++ CLI extension using `SlicerExecutionModel` and `ITK`; it does not touch Slicer's Python environment (`requirements.txt` is only used by `.readthedocs.yaml` to build documentation).

packaging.rationale: Inspected root `CMakeLists.txt` and all four module `CMakeLists.txt` and `.xml` files. All four CLI modules (`AADImageFilter`, `IADImageFilter`, `AADDiffusionWeightedData`, `AADEPIData`) are properly configured with `SEMMacroBuildCLI` and match the catalog entry.

license.rationale: Inspected `LICENSE`, `README.md`, `docs/index.md`, and source headers. The extension is licensed under the Apache License 2.0, which clearly permits distribution.

soundness.rationale: Inspected the ITK filter implementations and CLI entry points across all four modules. There are minor bugs including multi-iteration updates inside `ThreadedGenerateData` without inter-thread synchronization, an unused CLI parameter (`homoLevel`), and template leftovers in CTest files.

utility.rationale: Inspected `README.md`, `docs/index.md`, and the four CLI XML descriptions. The algorithms are backed by peer-reviewed publications and provide useful MRI denoising filters with documentation and example images.

findings.title: Data race and unsynchronized boundary reads across iterations in ThreadedGenerateData
findings.explanation: In `AnisotropicAnomalousDiffusionImageFilter` (across `AADImageFilter`, `AADEPIData`, and `AADDiffusionWeightedData`) and `IsotropicAnomalousDiffusionImageFilter`, the filter implements `ThreadedGenerateData`, meaning ITK splits the output image into subregions across worker threads. Inside `ThreadedGenerateData`, the filter performs multiple diffusion iterations (`m_Iterations`) copying `aux` back to `output` within each thread's subregion without inter-thread synchronization between iterations, and reads boundary neighbors from adjacent thread regions concurrently while other threads are writing to `output`. This causes a data race along thread region boundaries and mathematically inconsistent multi-iteration results when `m_Iterations > 1` and multiple threads are used.
findings.suggestion: Either override `GenerateData()` (single-threaded outer iteration loop invoking a single-step `ThreadedGenerateData` or `FiniteDifferenceImageFilter` pattern) or set `this->SetNumberOfWorkUnits(1)` in the constructor so that multi-iteration updates are synchronized across the whole image.

findings.title: CLI parameter `homoLevel` is never passed to the filter in AADImageFilter.cxx
findings.explanation: `AADImageFilter.xml` defines the `homoLevel` (`--homogeneity`) parameter for the Logistic edge function, and `itkAnisotropicAnomalousDiffusionImageFilter.h` defines `itkSetMacro(H, float)`, but `AADImageFilter.cxx` never passes `homoLevel` to `filter->SetH(homoLevel)`. Consequently, changes to "Homogeneity Level" in the GUI have no effect (it always uses the default `0.98`).

findings.title: Unconstrained conductance and regularization factor allow division by zero
findings.explanation: In `AADImageFilter.xml`, `conductance` and `kappaRegFactor` have no `<constraints>` preventing `0.0`. In `AADImageFilter.cxx`, dividing by `kappaRegFactor` when it is `0` or setting `conductance` to `0` results in division by zero in `EdgeWeightedController` (`.../ static_cast<InputPixelType>(m_Conductance)`).
findings.suggestion: Add positive minimum constraints in the XML files for `conductance` and `kappaRegFactor`, and guard against zero in the C++ code.

findings.title: Histogram lowerBound and upperBound sized to binsPerDimension instead of MeasurementVectorSize
findings.explanation: In `AutomaticConductanceImageCalculator::ComputeCanny`, `lowerBound` and `upperBound` are initialized with size `binsPerDimension` (256) instead of `MeasurementVectorSize` (1), whereas `size` has length `MeasurementVectorSize` (1). In ITK's `ImageToHistogramFilter`, the measurement vector length must match the number of components (1 for scalar images).

findings.title: CTest configurations pass non-existent `--sigma` flag from CLI template
findings.explanation: All four module `Testing/Cxx/CMakeLists.txt` files retain the template test invocation passing `--sigma 2.5`, which is not a valid CLI flag for any of the four modules (`AADImageFilter`, `IADImageFilter`, `AADEPIData`, `AADDiffusionWeightedData`). Running CTest will fail on argument parsing.
findings.suggestion: Update the test command arguments in each module's `Testing/Cxx/CMakeLists.txt` to pass flags defined in the respective module XML (and appropriate 4D/DWI test inputs for `AADEPIData` and `AADDiffusionWeightedData`).

not_checked: Build and runtime execution of the C++ CLI modules against Slicer superbuild
